name: paisa-expense-ledger
description: Paisa expense ledger — React frontend, Express API, MySQL database

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.render:build: npm ci --omit=dev && npm --prefix backend ci --omit=dev && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
